import string
import unicodedata


def check_if_last_char_is_a_letter(txt):
    last = txt.split(' ')[-1]
    if len(last) == 1 and ord(last) > 127 and unicodedata.category(last).startswith('L'):
        return False
    return len(last) == 1 and last in string.ascii_letters
